summary: Vitalik 发文回应“AI 找漏洞让安全代码不可能”的说法，认为 AI 辅助形式化验证是乐观的重要理由。ERC-8265 预备交易信封与交易事件清单 EIP 草案都在解决“用户签的和最终执行的不一致”的问题。ACDT #80 上 EIP-7954 合约大小上限更新为 64KiB。_julianma 宣布离开 EF。

items.title: ERC-8265：预备交易信封
items.note: 15:40（mike-diamond），对应 ERCs #1753 提交：定义一个链下信封，把已准备但未签名的交易、批处理或签名请求，从准备方（中继、DeFi 前端、intent solver、多签协调器、硬件钱包配套应用）传给签名方。
items.note_en: 15:40 (mike-diamond), with ERCs #1753 submitted: an offchain envelope that carries a prepared but unsigned transaction, batch or signature request from the producer that prepared it (a relayer, DeFi UI, intent solver, multisig coordinator or hardware wallet companion) to the consumer that signs it.

items.title: EIP 草案：交易事件清单，一份签名的、由协议强制执行的交易可产生事件声明
items.note: 17:29（zergity）：用户今天签的是 calldata 而不是结果，恶意前端、代理升级、状态漂移都可能让结果与钱包模拟不同，草案让协议把执行绑定到签名时声明的事件。
items.title_en: EIP draft: Transaction Event Manifest, a signed, protocol-enforced declaration of what a tx may emit
items.note_en: 17:29 (zergity): today users commit to calldata, not outcomes, and a malicious frontend, proxy upgrade or state drift can produce a result different from the wallet's simulation; the draft has the protocol bind execution to the events declared at signing.

summary_en: Vitalik responded to the claim that AI bug finding will make secure code impossible, arguing that AI-assisted formal verification is a major reason for optimism. The ERC-8265 prepared transaction envelope and a transaction event manifest EIP draft both target the gap between what users sign and what finally executes. On ACDT #80, EIP-7954's contract size limit was updated to 64KiB. _julianma announced he is leaving the EF.
